description: Send a general email — an answer to an enquiry or any message the user asks for (comms scope). Sent from the account's own return address. Give a client_id (uses their email on file, and logs the email to their history) or an explicit `to` address. body is plain text unless html=true. dry_run=true previews without sending.

body.description: The message or email body (HTML or text, per the tool).

booking_id.description: A booking's id (from list_bookings or search).

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

dry_run.description: If true, preview the result without sending or saving anything.

to.description: The recipient — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

name: send_email
title: Send Email
